book.name: MATTA
book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Karapu aten wutsǝfayid kakhrha
Nggǝrgha Yeeso pǝrang laɓara kanda tǝ karapu, ndǝghǝn,
Kutǝryid talara nǝghǝn ƙǝla kutǝra ngwagha fa ka ǝna wutsǝfayid kakhrha nǝn a wanggǝn.
Thlǝnanggǝn mafayighǝn ɗǝ ɗa nda aah nafina ɓa mbu nanda kanda ɓa, amma kar nafini ɓarha fa ɓa.
Tǝrgha nggǝrghǝn thlǝn fingya mafaya ɗǝ tǝ ndaarha, “Ndaaman nafini mbu ni, ngwaɗi wutsǝfayidɗa fa, thleeɗi urad thlaaya na ndǝndaura tǝ kwelya, ngwaɗi fa, ɓamaɓa ƙǝkar.”
Amma nafini mbu nǝn ɗǝf wanda teena sǝ wa, tal ɗǝgha heeɗǝ, tahadghǝn ƙǝm ɗǝgha ka ǝna shafilidghǝn ɗǝ.
Fingya ƙǝsang ngganda mafayighǝn hai, ɗǝk kanda nda tǝ kǝm ɓǝllang ngganda kanda.
Hufgha kutǝrɗi hur kaan. Thlǝnanggǝn sodjayighǝn ɗǝ ɓǝllang ngganda fa ɓǝl fayina ɗǝ, tǝ kǝm njang ngganda wupǝri ndan ɗǝ.
Tǝrgha ndanggǝn mafayighǝn, ʻNgwala ngwa wutsǝfayid kahadɗa fa, amma nafini mbu nǝm ɓa mbǝ kanda ni kamngga a ɓa nda ɓa wa.
“Nanǝnya, ɗaama hu kwaman hu wuraya ɗǝ mbu fiya nun ɓa kala niifa nanun ɓa nda hu wutsǝfayidɗa ɓa.”
Nanǝn kee, ɗǝgha mafayini ahu kwaman hu wuraya ɗǝ mbu ka nafiya nda ɓa na nanda tǝ ndǝrwaya, lǝghǝdgha ƙǝn wutsǝfayid kahadɗi tǝ rongya.
Amma kyana kutǝr ɗa ɓa ka ɓagha na ronggi ni mbunǝn ɓa, na niifa nǝn kalwawa kari yi wutsǝfayid kahadɗi.
Tsahang mee nǝn, “Pashinna, ƙǝƙǝn kyana mbǝɗa ɓa ya kula sa kal karid wutsǝfayid kahadɗa fa?” Amma mbangwa kamshiɗi nggǝrang sǝ wa.
Tǝrgha kutǝrɗi ndanggǝn nafiya na ǝnang taara, “Ƙǝnaman haarghǝn tǝ sarghǝn muwanggun ƙǝshaaɗǝ ahu wula ɗǝ mbǝɗi nanda a tǝrha tǝ ƙǝt mee.”
“Ƙǝsǝr nafiya hangga aah nanda, amma ngguchit wurna nda hasǝ.”
Tsakhmee aten tii tsamnda a Kaisar
Tǝrgha Farisayini wuma nda hai kaɗa kwamana nda a ɗǝfang takthleera nda Yeeso ka a thlǝk ˈya nǝn tǝna nda ƙǝsang nda.
Thlǝn fatsaha yindan nda ɗǝ tǝ nafiya Hirdus ka a tsahang mee nda, ndaa nda, “Mala sǝnɗansǝ ka niifa ni sa, na tsahang kwaman Faara fiya ha tǝ ƙǝkafekkirha. Sa kǝm mba wurahasǝ wa.
Nanǝnya pǝranggǝn kan, mani numad wa aten ǝnɗiya, nǝghǝn mǝmǝl a teng tsamnda nan kaisar wa nduwa awo?”
Amma Yeeso sǝnɗǝ numad mɓǝlfedɗi na ahur ndan, ndagha, “Kun fathlǝrɓuya, kama na mid nun a ɗǝfee takthleera?
Keɗeema pene tii tsamndǝɗi. Fǝrang pene ɗa nda.”
Tsahang mee nǝn kanda, “Shishingnda wunni tǝ thlǝm wun a tenggǝn?”
Ndang ngganda, “Yi Kaisar.” Ndanggǝn kanda, “Fǝraman Kaisar ˈya tsauka yi Kaisar, tǝ kǝm fǝraman Faara ˈya tsauka yi Faara.”
Sǝk nanda kee, ǝna ǝnwulteena nda pa wii fayindan nda.
Tsakhmee aten thliirha sǝ ahu mǝrra tǝ kakhrha
Tsu a farɗi fingya Sadukiyaya ndagha mbǝ thliirha sǝ hu mǝra wa ɓa nda thlǝmad Yeeso ɓa tǝ tsakhmee.
Ndang ngganda, “Mala, ndangga Musa kan, ‘A mǝr wan man niifa malɗǝ nukkun hai kula nggǝtta, na wan man tǝrangsǝ hu langaarha ka a nggǝɗanggǝn sǝ.’
Nanǝnya, na nafiya sǝ mǝd a wanmanggi. Tǝ pamǝnda kakhka mǝrgha kula wal wee, tǝrgha yi sǝri tǝranggǝn nuɗasǝ.
Amma wan man yi sǝri mǝrgha ƙǝm, yi mahan wai kee har ta ten yi mǝd ɗǝ.
Akwasamadghǝn, nuɗi ƙǝm mǝrgha.
Nanǝnya, ahu thliirha sǝ hu mǝrra na nuɗi tsaurha yi wun tsaunǝn kanda heu mǝd, tǝrang nda nuɗasǝ?”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “Numad nun mbǝ mǝmǝl wa ƙǝsǝr sǝnggun Laɓar Faara na chichireethlee hai tǝ sǝsǝmndǝghǝn wa.
Thliirha sǝ hu mǝra mbǝ nishya tǝ hǝshya kakhrha wa. Nanda tsaurha kǝla fathlǝngya Faara a talara.
Amma aten thliirha sǝ hu mǝra, karantanggun ˈya ndang na laɓar Faara kun wa?
‘Nggini Faara yi Ibrahim, Faara yi Ishaku, tǝ ƙǝm Faara yi Yakubu’. Mbǝ Faara ni yi mǝrya wa, amma yi fingya natǝ yibrha fa.”
Sǝkna fiya ndǝn wumngga hai, ǝna ǝnwulteena nda tǝ tsahayighǝn ha.
Ngyakhrha na manggǝn
Amma sǝkna Farisayini tǝ ndaarha nggǝlangga Yeeso mii Sadukiyayini tǝ laɓaara nggǝrang nǝn kanda sǝ, wuma nda hai ka a nggǝra nda tsahang mee.
Tal ahur famalǝmngya ɗeleewar Musa, na midghǝn sǝ a ɗǝfang takthleera nǝn tsahang mee nǝn Yeeso,
“Mala yanggini manggǝn ahur ngyakhkya heu?”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso, “Nggǝmu Chinǝm Faarwa tǝ hurwa heu, tǝ shingnduwa heu tǝ huten wa heu.
Yanɗiya ndǝna katǝra ngyakhrha na mam.
Yi sǝri ƙǝm nǝghǝn manggǝn: ʻNggǝmu tuladwa ƙǝla altenwa.
Ngyakhrha heu tǝ tsahad annabiya ha na nda aten ngyakhkini sǝri ya.”
Tsakh mee aten Ƙǝrǝsti
Wumna Farisaya hai tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda,
“Mani numad nun aten Ƙǝrǝsti? Wan wunni?” Ndang ngganda, “Wan Ndauda ni.”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “Ƙǝƙǝn na Ndauda tǝ sǝsǝmnda Sǝsǝna aaghǝn ‘Chinǝm’? Ƙǝsǝr ndagha Ndauda,

content.text: Ana Ndauda a aah Ƙǝrǝsti ‘Chinǝm,’ ƙǝƙǝn nǝn tsaurha wanggǝn?”

content: Mbǝ niifa sǝ mbangga nggǝrang sǝ wa, ka farɗi mbǝ niifa sǝ ndengga yidghǝn nggǝrghǝn tsahang mee wa.
